title: Wire complete mike_trade app and reference VWAP shadow end-to-end lifecycle
description:
Wire the full production application composition root and runtime lifecycle. Then prove the mandatory credentials-free vwap_reference shadow lifecycle and the restart/offline recovery behavior with end-to-end tests that use production components rather than a demo runner.

Before editing, inspect:
- mike_trade/app.py and mike_trade/runtime.py (existing composition/bootstrap code)
- mike_trade/controls/service_manager.py (t.1 instance lock and graceful shutdown expectations)
- mike_trade/persistence/ (SQLite WAL single writer, migrations, integrity checks, projections, heartbeat)
- mike_trade/market_data/ (shared feed, cache, candle/indicator service, IEX provenance, warmup/freshness)
- mike_trade/strategies/ (vwap_bounce, vwap_breakdown, vwap_reference pairing, registry)
- mike_trade/execution/, mike_trade/risk/, mike_trade/protection/, mike_trade/reconciliation/, mike_trade/shadow/ (coordinator, eligibility, budgets, cooldown, lockouts, shadow broker and ledger)
- mike_trade/brokers/ (port interfaces and adapters)
- mike_trade/dashboard/ (heartbeat/OFFLINE logic consumers)
- existing tests/end_to_end/ fixtures and tests/conftest.py

Implementation requirements:
1. mike_trade/app.py: a dependency-injected composition root that builds, for a selected mode (BACKTEST, SHADOW with one or more named scenarios, PAPER, LIVE), the clock, calendar, persistence (mode-specific database path), market-data service, candle/indicator engine, strategy registry, risk/eligibility, budget manager, execution coordinator, protection coordinator, reconciliation service, broker adapter (simulated/shadow for SHADOW and BACKTEST, Alpaca paper/live for PAPER/LIVE), and scheduler. It must keep cross-mode credentials, databases, and ledgers isolated and refuse LIVE without explicit authorization.
2. mike_trade/runtime.py: an explicit startup state machine in this order: acquire instance lock -> open/migrate/integrity-check the mode database -> load durable controls and config fingerprint -> validate credentials, provider capabilities, clock/calendar (including early close), and asset eligibility -> fetch broker account, open/linked orders, positions, recent activities -> match broker facts to local intents/fills exactly once -> classify external positions as UNMANAGED and detect orphan stops -> resolve ambiguous cancel/fill/replace state -> verify budget reservations, entry eligibility, strategy state, and protective coverage -> warm required market data -> establish feed and order-update freshness -> RUNNING. New entries are allowed only when reconciled and authorized; any failure leaves entries blocked with explicit drift/reason. Write heartbeat rows for the dashboard. Graceful shutdown on SIGTERM/SIGINT: block new entries, drain in-flight evaluations, flush state, unsubscribe feeds cleanly, release the lock, and leave positions and valid protective stops untouched. Pause, stop, close, and flatten must remain distinct operations.
3. tests/end_to_end/test_full_product_cycle.py (offline, deterministic, no credentials): drive the real production evaluator, coordinator, shadow broker, and ledger with deterministic completed 1-minute regular-session bars to prove: completed-bar VWAP upward cross triggers vwap_bounce BUY -> exactly one shadow entry (duplicate signals on the same bar and repeated signals/partial fills do not create a second entry) -> simulated protective order on the filled quantity -> (path A) vwap_breakdown SELL after minimum hold with coordinated stop cancellation and full remaining exit, and (path B) stop-first exit -> full close -> exact Decimal cash and P&L -> post-sale cooldown -> rearm -> WATCHING_BUY. Also cover 1-symbol and 10-symbol shared-feed fanout with one data acquisition per symbol, independent BUY/SELL parameterization, daily entry-cycle cap and session reset, symbol and buy-strategy loss lockouts, concurrent budget race, scenario isolation across concurrent named shadow scenarios, early-close-aware entry cutoff, default no EOD liquidation, exact ledger/report reconciliation for whole and fractional fills, and deterministic no-lookahead replay.
4. tests/end_to_end/test_recovery_offline.py (offline): prove restart safety: restart mid-cycle preserves shadow state and accounting deterministically; restart with an outstanding order, an active protective stop, and an external position results in exact-once fill matching, an UNMANAGED external position, a detected orphan stop, and entries blocked until reconciled; a second instance fails to acquire the lock; migration/integrity failure blocks startup; graceful shutdown leaves stops/positions untouched; persistent cooldown and lockouts survive restart; and a stale heartbeat makes the dashboard read model report OFFLINE with stale-marked last-known values.
acceptance_criteria: mike_trade/app.py builds the full object graph per mode through dependency injection. SHADOW and BACKTEST never construct an Alpaca adapter, and LIVE construction fails without explicit authorization.

mike_trade/runtime.py implements the documented startup order and permits new entries only after reconciliation succeeds and entries are authorized. Any failed step leaves entries blocked with a recorded reason.
Runtime graceful shutdown blocks entries, drains, flushes, unsubscribes, releases the instance lock, and does not cancel protective stops or close positions.

test_full_product_cycle.py exercises production vwap_bounce/vwap_breakdown via vwap_reference through the real coordinator, shadow broker, and ledger (no special demo runner) and asserts exactly one entry, duplicate-bar suppression, protective order creation, both the SELL-with-stop-cancel path and the stop-first path, exact Decimal cash/P&L, cooldown, and return to WATCHING_BUY.

test_full_product_cycle.py covers 1- and 10-symbol shared-feed fanout, daily entry-cycle cap/reset, loss lockouts, concurrent budget race, scenario isolation, early-close cutoff, default no EOD liquidation, fractional/whole ledger reconciliation, and no-lookahead replay.

test_recovery_offline.py asserts exact-once fill matching on restart, UNMANAGED classification of external positions, orphan stop detection, entries blocked until reconciled, lock contention failure, migration/integrity failure blocking, persistence of cooldown/lockouts across restart, and dashboard OFFLINE/stale behavior from heartbeat age.
Both end-to-end test modules run without network access or broker credentials.
forbidden_changes: change PLAN_SKELETON.json or any planning artifacts under .abracapocus/
create a special demo runner or hardcoded BUY fixture in place of production strategy evaluation
contact Alpaca paper or live endpoints from these tests
liquidate positions or cancel protective stops on shutdown
run broad test suites, backtests, or data downloads as incidental verification
